item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I really want to like this because I love ooo-ooo-ooo-ooo-ooo-ooo-ooo with all my heart and I want more of it, but I don't think this quite reaches the same level of awesome. This doesn't match the sheer absurdity of the Fuck Patrol and its unusual members- not as outrageously weird. Sure, we have some witty dialogue and a twist ending in which the villain wins, but it isn't nearly as refreshing or exciting. The self-awareness of writing tropes and mechanisms isn't utilised as well; they feel more like decorations than integral plot points, here, used as one-offs to remind the reader that this is meta. The grocery store music isn't quite as sinister, the action isn't as intense, this ends up feeling like a lesser version of its predecessor.

I am glad to see an addition to one of the most enjoyable universes on the site, but this doesn't quite cut it from me.
